description: Localized item names, descriptions, currency/quantity formats and unlock messages. Item/ItemSet/PlayerCard rows reference this table by Id_ItemText, and GameItem helpers add type-specific parameters before resolution.

ID.simple: Item text id (row key), e.g. ITM_MONEY_1001, ITM_COSTUME_1001.
ID.technical: FName ID in FGameDataTableRow_GameText, used as FindRow key. FGameDataTableRow_Item, ItemSet, PlayerCardTitle and PlayerCardNickname carry Id_ItemText FNames that feed GameItem_GetNameTextCore; that helper may replace the id with a cosmetic wrapper id (ITM_COSTUME_1001, ITM_CUSTOM_VOICE_1001, ITM_SITUATION_OVERVIEW_POSE_1001) or transform it via PlayerCard_MakeNicknameTextId for nickname top/bottom variants. Shop unlock text also calls GetGameText with hard-coded ITM_UNLOCK_MESSAGE_*. The table is loaded as ItemTextDataTable_<Language> in slot 3 of the combined GameText array.

Text.simple: Localized item name/description/message, possibly with formatting placeholders and rich-text images.
Text.technical: FString row text (+0x10), copied by GetGameText and run through FormatText. In this group the En export uses (integer with grouping/width options), and (nested text-id parameters) plus glossary tags (492 GLO, 97 DYN occurrences in En). GameItem_GetNameTextCore supplies ITEM_VALUE for Money, ITEM_NAME + CHARACTER_NAME for Costume/CustomVoice/SituationOverviewPose, and redirects nickname ids. Rich-text markup such as is parsed by GameWidgetRichTextBlock. With bWithValue=false, money bypasses the table id and formats the raw integer via GroupDigits instead. Empty rows are common in non-en/zh variants (e.g. 1974 empty Zh rows in the export), and HasGameTextContent tests for emptiness before using a title/nickname label.

notes: FGameDataTableRow_GameText with 11 language variants, 4817 identical ids each in the companion export. Slot 3 of the 14-table array; Config/DefaultGame.ini:35-45 cooks one variant per chunk.

Cross-table joins: ItemTypeId -> Item.Id_ItemText -> this table, with EquipmentItemEffect.BuffDebuff/FloatValue and Effect.Id_BattleText supplying DYN=VALUE for description templates (GameItemDescriptionTextWidget.cpp:218-271); PlayerCardTitle/Nickname Id_ItemText -> title/nickname labels (GamePlayerCardParameter.cpp:517-566); shop lineups append ITM_UNLOCK_MESSAGE_4050; free-battle/visual-lobby costume selectors map costumes to item text ids.
Some ids in this table are used only after transformation (nickname top/bottom by language) or as nested parameters, so the literal row name seen in a widget may differ from the exported id.

Reconstruction caveat: GameItem helpers and text manager GetText paths are byte-matched in status, while FindTextRow/Tick are behaviour-certified (0x14af290, 0x14c96f0; BG03). Partial Content only; no retail Blueprint-only usage claims.

usages.detail: GameItem_GetNameText reads Item->Id_ItemText and delegates to the type-aware helper that builds the final GameTextRequest.
GameItem_GetNameTextCore redirects ids for Money/Costume/CustomVoice/SituationOverviewPose/Nickname and adds ITEM_VALUE, ITEM_NAME, CHARACTER_NAME parameters.
GameItem_GetNameTextById resolves an item id to its Item row and then to ItemText via the same helper.
Builds a plain GameTextRequest from PlayerCardTitle/Nickname Id_ItemText and checks HasGameTextContent before use.
Appends GetGameText of a lineup unlock id plus ITM_UNLOCK_MESSAGE_4050 for locked shop items.
Calls GetGameText(GameItem_GetNameText(...)) and requires more than one character before displaying an archive text entry.
